data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction

 KPIs

* OTIF delivery

* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness

data.jd_text:
DAMAC Group is consolidating its enterprise application landscape around Oracle Fusion — and we need a leader who can own it. This is not a maintenance role. It is a strategic and delivery leadership position with full accountability for a complex, multi\-system portfolio across one of the largest real estate and hospitality groups in the GCC.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 You will own Oracle Fusion ERP strategy and delivery end\-to\-end, govern a managed services ecosystem, lead a team of 50\+, and drive the enterprise application roadmap across real estate, hospitality, and corporate systems .
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




  




* Oracle Fusion ERP — strategy, roadmap, and programme delivery
* Full enterprise application portfolio: PMIS, CRM, hospitality systems, integration platforms
* AMS provider governance — SLA, commercial performance, escalation
* Team of 50\+ across direct and indirect reports
* Budget ownership and Board\-level reporting



  





**What You Bring** 




  




* 15\+ years in enterprise IT, 12\+ in senior leadership
* Oracle Fusion ERP implementation at programme director level — not advisory
* Managed services provider governance experience with direct SLA accountability
* Broad enterprise portfolio: PMIS, CRM, integration — Yardi or PMWeb a plus
* Consulting background (programme director / practice lead) considered strongly

**Introduction**
**Come move the world with us!**
 Wake up each day to be part of a
 **global movement** 
 . A movement to make an impact. A movement to go for it! A movement to provide best\-in class solutions. A movement to be empowered. A movement to do the right thing.
   

  

 Make AIT Worldwide Logistics the next stop on your career journey!
   

  

 See what our teammates say about working at AIT Worldwide Logistics .
   

  

**Overview**
 Manager – Planning \& Business Solutions for Energy \& Projects vertical supports the execution and delivery of AIT’s Energy \& Projects (E\&P) solutions strategy within the IMEA region. The role focuses on commercial execution, customer support, operational coordination, and product deployment, contributing to sustainable and profitable growth in line with regional and corporate objectives.
   

  

 The Manager partners closely with the Director – Energy \& Projects, regional leadership, and cross‑functional teams to support business development initiatives, ensure operational excellence, and maintain strong relationships with customers and service providers involved in complex Energy and Project logistics solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate end‑to‑end execution of Energy, Oil \& Gas, and Project Cargo movements across India \& Middle East region, ensuring safety, regulatory compliance, and on‑time delivery.
* Serve as the operational and technical subject‑matter expert for Energy \& Project cargo, including OOG, breakbulk, modules, skids, and engineered movements supporting upstream, midstream, and downstream projects.
* Manage routing, carrier selection, vessel planning, equipment configuration, permits, surveys, and method‑of‑transport execution in alignment with approved SOPs, HSE plans, and EPC requirements.
* Coordinate carriers, heavy‑haul and SPMT providers, ports, terminals, yards, and third‑party service providers to ensure capacity availability, service continuity, and effective risk mitigation in Oil \& Gas environments.
* Monitor shipment‑ and project‑level cost performance, supporting margin integrity and compliance with approved commercial frameworks and customer contractual requirements.
* Support tender execution for Energy \& Oil \& Gas projects through operational feasibility assessments, execution methodology reviews, and pricing inputs within defined authority limits.
* Collaborate with regional pricing and procurement teams to validate rates, equipment availability, and market conditions, sharing intelligence on carrier capacity and cost drivers within the Energy sector.
* Track operational KPIs related to safety, schedule adherence, cost control, and execution quality, implementing corrective actions for deviations.
* Act as a first‑level operational escalation point for complex, high‑risk, or cross‑border Energy \& Project shipments, including shutdowns, critical\-path cargo, and remote site deliveries.
* Ensure full compliance with HSE, DG, project QA/QC standards, and customer‑specific Oil \& Gas and Energy project requirements.
* Collaborate with regional leadership, sales, engineering, and operations teams to improve execution capability, standardization, and delivery performance across Energy \& Projects programs.


**Qualifications**
* A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value!
* A strong work ethic with an appreciation for ownership, independence, accountability and autonomy in your role.
* Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently.
* Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture!


**Other Skills We Hope To See**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 8–12 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or project cargo, within Energy or Industrial Projects.
* Experience supporting P\&L performance, pricing, or commercial activities.
* Exposure to Air, Ocean, and Project logistics operations.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and geographies preferred.
* Strong coordination, communication, and problem‑solving skills.
* Process‑oriented with attention to detail and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrate a great deal of initiative and a strong hands\-on mentality
* High customer and service orientation
* High ability to work under pressure in a matrix environment and willingness to travel
* Demonstrates sound judgment and the ability to operate effectively in complex, high‑risk environments.


**About AIT Worldwide**
 AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps its customers grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure raw materials, components, and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the America’s\-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, food, government, healthcare, high\-tech, industrial and life sciences. Backed by scalable, user\-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door\-to\-door deliveries via sea, air, ground, and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 100 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe, India, and North America, AIT’s full\-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services. Learn more about AIT Worldwide Logistics, our culture and core values in action here .
   

  

**What AIT Can Offer You**
 In addition to base compensation, AIT offers a growing suite of competitive benefits to help our teammates realize their full financial, well\-being, personal and professional potential.
   

  

**AIT Worldwide Logistics Benefits Available Across All Global Markets**
* Vacation/holiday time
* Global employee support program
* Mindfulness tools
* Professional development
* Company events and gatherings
* Five paid volunteer hours through our AIT Cares program


 Our competitive employee benefits packages may vary by region and country.

data.jd_text:
We are currently seeking a Digital Portfolio Sales Account Executive who will be responsible for planning, developing and managing competitive sales campaigns both nationally and internationally. This position will be instrumental with proactively executing sales and delivery activities to customers within the assigned region. They will work to develop customer solutions by coordinating and integrating with internal and external processes and organizations to provide a competitive advantage and to foster business growth while meeting targeted business margins. The Digital Portfolio is represented in the market by teams composed of the Sales Director with responsibility for customer account strategy and growth, a Technical Sales representative to address technology and IT issues and a Services representative managing adoption of existing business.
   

  

 This position is based in the UAE.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Drives sales and campaign activities to successful completion by integrating multiple aspects of the customers' needs in a consultative manner
* Crafts campaign specific strategies, secures and manages resources and secures management commitment to ensure successful execution
* Initiates, maintains, and advances customer relationships and works to be accepted as a trusted business partner by the customer
* Establishes, maintains, and expands the network to address customer needs and keep lines of communication open
* Identifies future business opportunities and promotes the value of Jeppesen ForeFlight portfolio and partnership
* Leads preparation of proposals by developing themes and discriminators and ensures correct members and resources are included in the team
* Leads negotiations and finalizes commitments, ensuring mutual benefit to the customer and company by interfacing directly with customer decision\-makers and influencers
* Leverages detailed understanding of both customer and company needs and resources to find areas of alignment and integration
* Coordinates packaging of company and industry products and knowledge into complete solutions that meets customer needs
* Leverages company resources by building and leading a capture team to support customer commitments, gain a competitive advantage and foster business growth by using a comprehensive understanding (breadth and depth) of multiple products and services, process and operations, and resources
* Leads the approval process by advocating the customer requirements and selling the business case to management to ensure quality deals
* Balances the enterprise, business unit and customer goals to meet and drive Long Range Business Plan (LRBP)
* Acts as a mentor to colleagues regarding capturing and documenting detailed customer knowledge and assists in network development


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent experience
* 5 or more years sales and marketing experience
* 5 years of experience with complex sales, multi\-stakeholder B2B sales and software solutions
* Must be fluent in English
* Experience driving campaign and account strategy with go\-to\-market stakeholders
* Proven ability to successfully influence internal partners to drive new business
* Working knowledge in software solutions or software development


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5 years experience in software sales
* Fluency in Arabic is an advantage
* Experience with Salesforce as CRM solution
* Commercial Aviation industry or airline experience
* Business proficiency or fluency in Russian
* Pilot or aviation enthusiast


**About Jeppesen ForeFlight**
 Jeppesen ForeFlight is a leading provider of innovative aviation software solutions, serving the Commercial, Business, Military, and General Aviation sectors globally. Combining Jeppesen’s 90\-year legacy of accurate aeronautical data with ForeFlight’s expertise in cutting\-edge aviation technology, the company delivers an integrated suite of tools designed to enhance safety, improve operational efficiency, and sharpen decision\-making.
   

  

**Why You Should Join**
 At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we know you want a rewarding career. To do that, you need challenging projects, a good work environment, and awesome coworkers. We believe in our employees, and we empower them to make a direct impact on our products and services messaging. We strive to provide employees and their loved ones with a world\-class benefits experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Our benefits package includes but is not limited to the following:
   

  

* Medical and dental insurance with employer paid health premiums for employees
* Employer paid life insurance
* Gym and wellbeing reimbursement
* 10 days of paid paternity leave
* 80 days of paid maternity leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* 2 days off to volunteer annually
* Employee referral program
* Flight rewards and flight stipend

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

data.jd_text:
**Job Description:**
 DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. DataRobot empowers practitioners to deliver predictive and generative AI, and enables leaders to secure their AI assets. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future.
   

  

**Purpose \& Overall Relevance for the Organization:**
 As RVP of Professional Services for Emerging Markets (middles east and Africa), you will be the most senior technical leader responsible for building, scaling, and driving the performance of DataRobot’s Professional Services organization, overseeing both the Forward Deployed Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams. You will own the end\-to\-end technical delivery lifecycle—from scoping and pitching professional services engagements to ensuring high\-quality delivery and production\-grade operationalization—while maintaining P\&L responsibility for the region.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 Commercial Strategy \& P\&L Ownership
   

  

  

* Own and manage the regional Professional Services P\&L, budget, and operating plan, ensuring achievement of margin targets and overall financial health of the regional services business.
* Lead the scoping, solutioning, and pitching of professional services for strategic opportunities, partnering closely with Sales to define high\-impact, value\-driven engagements.
* Collaborate with Regional Sales and Account Management leadership to build services strategies that support pipeline acceleration, revenue goals, and expansion.


 Professional Services Team Leadership \& Scaling
   

  

  

* Lead, scale, and develop the Professional Services organization, overseeing both the Forward Deployed Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams across MEA.
* Own workforce planning, capacity management, and resource utilization to efficiently balance team delivery against the dynamic book of business.
* Recruit, assess, and develop high\-performing technical talent, implementing performance management frameworks to recognize excellence and address underperformance.


 Delivery Excellence \& Operational Rigor
   

  

  

* Define and govern the regional service delivery methodology, ensuring consistent, repeatable, and high\-quality outcomes across the entire customer lifecycle (from onboarding to expansion).
* Define and enforce technical standards and MLOps best practices for customer deployments, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and maintainable at enterprise scale.
* Monitor customer satisfaction, delivery quality, and overall health of engagements to maximize customer impact and retention.


 Executive Engagement \& Alignment
   

  

  

* Serve as the senior technical point of contact and executive sponsor for strategic enterprise customers, engaging with C\-level stakeholders on delivery, architecture, and platform adoption strategies.
* Maintain tight alignment with Global Engineering and Deployment leadership on standards, tooling, and frameworks, ensuring MEA practices contribute to and are consistent with global strategy.
* Represent DataRobot externally as a thought leader at regional industry events, customer advisory boards, and partner forums.


 You will serve as the critical bridge between global strategy and regional execution. You will partner closely with Sales, marketing, and R\&D to align technical delivery capacity with revenue growth objectives across MEA, while instilling a culture of engineering excellence, operational rigor, and customer\-centricity within your team.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** 
 :
   

  

 Technical Expertise
   

  

  

* Deep, hands\-on expertise in deploying and integrating enterprise AI/ML platforms at scale across cloud and on\-premise environments.
* Strong architectural understanding of MLOps, model CI/CD pipelines, REST API design, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and enterprise data integration patterns.
* Proven ability to design and oversee deployment architectures for complex, regulated enterprise environments including financial services, healthcare, and government sectors common to the MEA region.
* Familiarity with Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) and their deployment considerations is a strong advantage.


 Leadership \& Management
   

  

  

* Demonstrated experience (minimum 3–5 years) leading and scaling regional or global deployment, solutions, or platform engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development across distributed geographies.
* Strong ability to manage a matrixed organization with both direct and dotted reporting lines across time zones.
* Exceptional executive\-level communication skills — able to translate technical complexity into clear business outcomes for C\-level audiences.


 Commercial Acumen
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of the commercial dynamics of a post\-sales technical function, including utilization management, delivery efficiency, and the relationship between technical success and revenue retention and expansion.


**Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications:**
**Experience**

data.jd_text:
**Deliveroo: A DoorDash Company:** 
 Deliveroo’s mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders. Following our successful 2025 merger with DoorDash, we have solidified our position as the global leader in local commerce. This partnership has expanded our footprint to over 45 markets and gives us access to industry\-leading technology and resources. It is a defining moment for our New Verticals business, specifically our 1P delivery\-only sites, Editions and HOP. We are no longer just a delivery app; we are building the infrastructure for the future of instant retail. There has never been a more exciting time to join the 'Roo family' as we integrate with the DoorDash ecosystem to redefine what is possible in the UAE and beyond.
   

  

**New Verticals \& Site Operations:** 
 As part of the DoorDash group, our New Verticals team is the primary global engine for testing and scaling the next generation of first party (1P) retail and automated logistics. We don't just facilitate orders; we own the sites that make them happen. While others act as simple aggregators, we own the infrastructure and the operations to ensure a premium, hyper\-fast experience.
   

  

* Deliveroo Editions: The world's first delivery\-only kitchens. We provide the specialised infrastructure and operational expertise that allow our restaurant partners to scale instantly.
* Deliveroo HOP: Our 1P speedy grocery service. We own the inventory, the technology, and the end\-to\-end fulfilment process to deliver groceries in as little as 15 minutes.


**The Role:** 
 The Regional Manager oversees the end\-to\-end operations of our proprietary, 1P delivery\-only sites across the UAE, spanning both our restaurant (Editions) and retail (HOP) verticals. This is a high\-impact leadership role that balances "boots\-on\-the\-ground" operational rigour with mid\-to\-long\-term strategic decision\-making. As the primary owner of these sites, you will be responsible for all of 1P success: Uncompromised safety, perfect stock integrity, and lightning\-fast throughput.
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Excellence**
 You will drive the business forward by optimising productivity, achieving site personnel cost targets, and minimising wastage/shrinkage. You must be a "Total Ownership" leader; comfortable working strategically to enhance our operating model within the global DoorDash ecosystem while fostering a positive, collaborative, and high\-performance culture for all site colleagues. Below are the 3 key areas this role is expected to manage:
   

  

* Site Governance: Set the "drumbeat" for the region by driving KPIs and supervising compliance with Standard Operating Procedures through impactful coaching.
* Site Presence: Maintain a constant physical presence at sites to ensure a "founder’s mindset" regarding cleanliness, efficiency, and quality.
* Safety \& Compliance: Act as the lead for regional regulatory relationships, ensuring 100% compliance with Dubai Municipality (DM), ADAFSA, etc.


**Financial \& Data Stewardship**
* P\&L Management: Manage the operational lines of the P\&L, tightly controlling labor and OpEx while minimising all forms of wastage/shrinkage.
* WBR/MBR Reporting: Host and participate in Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews. You will produce high\-quality, data\-driven written inputs that articulate regional performance and clear bridges with action plans.


**People \& Strategy**
* Team Development: Recruit, onboard, and mentor a high\-performing Area Manager team, managing the full organisational life cycle from talent development to HR/ER cases.
* Stakeholder Management: Own and champion relationships with host brand partners, site owners, and senior leadership within the wider DoorDash/Deliveroo business.
* Innovation: Lead projects and pilots aimed at testing the next generation of 1P retail and automated logistics.


**Requirements**
* Industry Leadership: Minimum of 3–4 years of F\&B, FMCG, or Grocery experience, with a proven track record in Area or Regional Management.
* Operational Ownership: While direct experience in a 1P environment is a significant advantage, it is essential you demonstrate a "Total Ownership" mindset. This means you are comfortable being the final point of accountability for site standards, stock accuracy, and the seamless hand\-off from inbound receiving to last\-mile dispatch.
* Rigorous Cost Control: Expert at managing and influencing the P\&L with a focus on operational expenditure. You possess the ability to identify inefficiencies and manage labor\-to\-order ratios effectively.
* Strong Writing \& Communication: Ability to craft concise, insightful narratives for WBR and MBR reports, translating raw data into "the why" and "the how" for senior leadership.
* Analytical \& Tech\-Savvy: Data\-driven decision\-maker with a high comfort level in numbers.
* Adaptability \& Autonomy: The grit to define how your role is best achieved in a fast\-paced, evolving environment with high levels of autonomy.
* People Leadership: Excellent ability to influence senior stakeholders while motivating a multi\-national, diverse site\-level workforce.
* Project Management: Capability to lead complex, cross\-functional projects from conception to completion.


**UAE Regulatory Knowledge (Preferred):** 
 Familiarity with navigating inspections and compliance requirements for DM, ADAFSA, and Civil Defence.

**Introduction To Role**
 The International region is AstraZeneca’s largest, most diverse and fastest\-growing region, representing around one\-third of total company revenue. We operate in a complex, rapidly evolving environment — and we are doubling down on growth and pipeline delivery to make Ambition 2030 a reality in International. At the heart of this is how we use AI, digital and data to transform our company, accelerate our science and maximize our impact for patients.
 *Ready to influence how a major global business runs its future?*
 We are looking for a dynamic individual to fulfil the role of

 . The successful candidate will be accountable for re\-wiring critical process to simplify and accelerate through AI and automation, starting with key performance analytics and annual business cycle processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be capable of navigating a senior leadership environment, securing progress with minimal direction, and showcasing proactive initiative.  Excellent cross functional leadership experience as well as an extensive knowledge of drug development and commercialization is crucial.  Digital \& AI for

* Pragmatism and can\-do attitude


*AstraZeneca offers the chance to shape the future of healthcare at scale, combining scientific strength with real\-world impact across diverse markets; work happens in an open, collaborative community where people learn from each other, stretch beyond their comfort zone and see a clear link between their efforts and better outcomes for patients, supported by leaders who value curiosity, sustainability and continuous development. If this role sparks your ambition to transform how data, AI and digital power impact for patients across the world, apply now to join the journey!*

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**




 To manage the facilities and operations within the assigned portfolio of assets/ buildings while implementing best supplier and customer relationship management, facilities management, building energy services management, maintenance, and contract management practices that improve the overall operational efficiency of managed assets, maintain high customer satisfaction,
 



 and help achieve Enova’s business objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities**



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Possesses extensive experience in key utilities, including but not limited to District cooling plants, Domestic water plant and network, Power distribution network, HV/LV substations and good knowledge in SCADA and BMS systems.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations as well as minor projects, mechanical \& HVAC works, electrical works, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to equipment, Turbines, Generators, Chillers, HVAC, pumps, sewage lifting stations, substations, infrastructure networks, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the client.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power interruptions, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems)
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services Enova provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented
* Ensure availability of MS and RA for outsourced works
* Ensure relevant emergency tests are conducted
* Ensure that all departmental reports are prepared timely and accurately and meet requirements, policies, and standards.
* Perform other related duties or assignments as directed



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, \& Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management especially in Malls /Hospitality projects

data.jd_text:
Messe Frankfurt Middle East is a trusted leader in the region’s B2B exhibition landscape, delivering impactful trade shows that shape industries and accelerate business growth. Based in Dubai, we are the regional arm of Messe Frankfurt GmbH, one of the world’s largest and most respected exhibition organisers, with a legacy of excellence spanning over 800 years. Our global network, industry expertise, and commitment to innovation enable us to create powerful business platforms that connect suppliers, buyers, and industry leaders worldwide.
 



  





 Our diverse and growing portfolio includes some of the Middle East’s most recognised trade fairs such as Intersec, Beautyworld Middle East, Automechanika Dubai, and Light \+ Intelligent Building Middle East. These events not only reflect evolving industry trends but also drive collaboration, innovation, and long\-term business growth across multiple sectors.
 



  





 We are looking for a highly organised and commercially aware Project Manager, Operations to join our Operations team. Acting as a key support across exhibition planning and delivery, this role plays a critical part in ensuring the smooth execution of events across the UAE and KSA, delivering operational excellence and a high\-quality experience for exhibitors, visitors, and stakeholders.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 




  





**Show Planning \& Operational Delivery** 



* Support the planning and delivery of exhibitions from pre\-show through to onsite and post\-show operations
* Coordinate with internal teams including Sales, Marketing, Creative, Finance, CRM, IT, and HR to ensure operational requirements are delivered effectively
* Manage operational timelines and workflows using project management tools such as Monday.com
* Support show budget tracking and maintain visibility of operational costs throughout the project lifecycle



**Venue \& Supplier Management** 



* Liaise closely with venues across the UAE and KSA including DWTC and other exhibition centres
* Coordinate venue services including security, housekeeping, catering, rigging, health \& safety, and logistics
* Manage communication with appointed contractors, suppliers, and service partners to ensure smooth event delivery
* Attend planning, kickoff, and final operational meetings with venue stakeholders and partners



**Exhibitor \& Technical Coordination** 



* Work alongside Technical teams to ensure floorplans, exhibitor portals, and operational requirements are delivered within agreed timelines
* Support exhibitors and third\-party suppliers with operational planning and onsite participation requirements
* Oversee show build\-up and breakdown, ensuring compliance with venue regulations and tenancy schedules



**Event Features, Branding \& Activations** 



* Coordinate exhibition signage, sponsorship branding, feature areas, VIP lounges, conferences, awards, and event activations
* Work closely with Marketing, Creative Studio, and external partners to ensure all deliverables are executed to a high standard and within deadlines



**Logistics, Registration \& General Operations** 



* Support shipping, customs clearance, onsite handling, registration requirements, staffing coordination, catering, internet, badges, and event materials
* Assist with post\-show reporting and continuous improvement initiatives across operational processes



**Accounting \& Budget Management** 



* Coordinate purchase orders, supplier quotations, and operational expenditure tracking in line with company procedures
* Monitor budgets and support cost control throughout the planning and delivery cycle



  





  





**What You’ll Bring:** 



* 5\+ years’ experience within exhibition or event operations, ideally in the UAE or KSA market
* Strong understanding of exhibition planning, venue operations, and supplier coordination
* Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and tight deadlines simultaneously
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive, solutions\-focused mindset
* Experience using Microsoft Office and project management tools such as Monday.com
* Ability to work effectively under pressure within a fast\-paced, international environment
* Strong attention to detail with a hands\-on and collaborative approach



  





  





**Why Join Us?** 




 At Messe Frankfurt Middle East, you’ll be part of a collaborative and high\-performing team delivering some of the region’s leading exhibitions and events. This role offers the opportunity to work across exciting international projects, build strong industry relationships, and play a key role in the successful delivery of large\-scale events across the Middle East.

data.jd_text:
**What We're All About.**
 It isn't often you get to be part of a tech company that, since 2016, has been innovating the data analytics market in ways no\-one else can. Our technology started out in FinTech, helping tackle serious criminal activity. Now, its potential is virtually limitless. Working at Quantexa isn't just intellectually stimulating. We're a real team. Collaborating and constantly engineering better and better solutions. We're ambitious, we think things through and we're on a mission to discover just how far we can go. Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We're made up of people from 60\+ nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.
   

  

 If our incredible culture sounds like you, we'd love you to join us.
   

  

**The opportunity.**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution and successful end\-to\-end delivery of implementation projects to our clients. You will join a wider Delivery team of engineers, analysts, data scientists and architects focused on achieving the best outcomes for our clients.
   

  

 You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.
   

  

 As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will also be working hand in hand with our delivery partner network, which includes the big four consultancies as well as major systems integrators.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing.**
* You will take full ownership of the delivery of Quantexa projects end\-to\-end, putting your arms around all aspects, actively mitigating risks and issues, driving high standards of quality and best practice and being in full control of the costs, timelines and scope.
* You'll drive successful outcomes \- delivering projects in the most optimal way that realise maximum value to our clients.
* Managing the commercial and financial aspects of your projects, working with our clients to agree contracts for professional services, using both Time and Materials (T\&M) and Fixed Priced constructs.
* Coaching and mentoring your technical teams to ensure they have the skills and capabilities necessary to produce high quality deliverables to our clients.
* Working and learning with a high degree of autonomy with minimal supervision, seeking and knowing when to engage the rest of the Quantexa organisation for support.
* You will devise critical strategies to successfully manage your project stakeholders, both from the client as well as Quantexa leadership.


**Requirements**
**What do I need to have?**
* You are an accomplished project management professional with strong leadership skills and a track record of delivering complex projects with excellent outcomes.
* You are an expert on project methodologies and approaches such as Agile, can apply them to maximum effect and you appreciate how these methodologies and approaches can scale to multiple teams and functions.
* You have broad stakeholder management experience either as a supplier delivering to clients, such as a consultancy or professional services organisation, or within a client\-side environment.
* You have experience of delivering large and complex data\-driven projects through the full software lifecycle.
* You have a good understanding of the technical aspects that impact the project outcomes and can grasp technical issues and devise mitigation strategies to address them.
* You have a strong appreciation of the business purpose and drivers of your projects and direct the team to ensure that achieving them is paramount.
* You are adept at operating in complex multi\-team environments where you harness your skills and knowledge to influence other teams to deliver the best overall outcome.
* You demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, critical thinking and the ability to devise delivery solutions to address client challenges.
* Exhibit strong technical communication skills with demonstrable experience of working in rapidly changing client environments.
* Have an excellent appreciation of what makes a high quality, operationally stable system and how to streamline all areas of development, release, and operations to achieve this.
* You are a self\-starter and bring a great deal of determination, initiative and tenacity to your projects.
* Proficiency in speaking Arabic at a fluent/native level is mandatory
* Comfortable traveling within the UAE and across the Gulf region as required for business needs and client engagements


**Ideal candidates will also:**
* Have worked on a variety of complex data orientated projects for financial services, government, and telco clients


**Benefits**
**Our perks and quirks.**
 What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.
   

  

 We offer:
   

  

* Competitive salary
* Company bonus
* 22 days annual leave, plus national holidays \+ your birthday off!
* Private Healthcare with Daman, including dental \& optic cover
* Regularly bench\-marked salary rates
* Well\-being days
* Volunteer Day off
* Work from Home Equipment
* Free Calm App Subscription \#1 app for meditation, relaxation and sleep
* Continuous Training and Development, including access to Udemy Business
* Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12\-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere' policy
* Employee Referral Program
* Team Social Budget \& Company\-wide Socials


**Our mission**
 We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We're not a start\-up. Not anymore. But we've not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction \- the future.
   

  

**It's All About You.**
 We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected—because it's your individuality and passion that make you
 *Q* 
 . We see that, and we celebrate it. That's why we're proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know—we're happy to assist.
   

  

 No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what's possible, we want to hear from you.

**Role Purpose** 

 Document Controllers are responsible for the timely, accurate and efficient preparation and management of documents in our Document Control System. Ensuring the efficient organisation, numbering, sorting, filing, storing and retrieval of both electronic and hard copy documents produced by technical teams, projects or departments for our projects.

**Key Accountabilities** 
* Responsible for overall coordination of controlled documentation within the Project(s) assigned.
* Perform Document Control function within validated Master Control system.
* Investigate and respond to corrective actions related to Document Control.
* Receive, direct and relay telephone calls and fax messages to Project Director.
* Receive, send, and prepare documents and ensure documents are complete and comprehensive in Transmittals while maintaining proper registers and filing.
* Prepare letters, internal and external memos, and documents including Transmittals Clearance, CVI, RFI, O\&M, Asset Register, etc.
* Ensure and verify all outgoing documents in transmittals are composed properly and accurately.
* Maintain accurate record of receipt and issue of transmittals.
* Maintain records of project documents in hard copies and electronic files as per project filing.
* Manage correspondence through MS Outlook and ACONEX.
* Arrange weekly MEP Reports.
* Handle all incoming and outgoing mails, correspondence and filling of records.
* Process leave applications and update daily manpower attendance; submit to timekeeper.
* Prepare Petty Cash Summary and payment certificates.
* Maintain general filing system and file all correspondence.
* Assist in planning and preparing meetings and conferences.
* Update logs on a daily basis.
* Compile project documents as per approved completion plan for handovers to clients.
* Ensure proper coordination with other site offices and subcontractors.
* Ensure strict adherence of HSE policies and procedures set
* Report HSE incidents/violations etc. to superiors on time
* Strict adherence of legal requirementsDrive innovation and encourage continuous improvement and cost\-effective solutions without compromising quality.


**Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge \& Skills** 
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration or other related field.
* 3\+ years experience working experience (preferred construction site experience)
* Should have the ability to operate individually and under supervision
* Ability to develop and maintain highly effective relationships, externally and internally
* Solid sense of confidentiality and discretion.
* Outstanding interpersonal, written, and communication skills.
* Ability to organize work effectively and prioritize with high attention to detail.
* Excellent PC skills including MS Office products
* Flexibility in order to adapt to varying and changing demands.

data.jd_text:
****Contexte et environnement****
 As a plant Assistant Manager \- Projects \& Maintenance Manager, the role involves collaboration with a diverse set of contacts across various organizational levels and functions:
   

  

* Collaborate with TotalEnergies HQ on capex investment LTP under various sections like statutory, security, safety \& environment, development, productivity, maintenance \& renewal and CO2e reduction and project execution
* Manage Asset integrity management process for the plant equipment by dealing with OEMs, local inspection agencies and facility management contractors.
* Dealing with various local government authorities to obtain NOCs to execute projects and post project inspections.


**Framework for the position's reflections**
* Implement instructions by optimizing processes


**Nature of the position's interactions**
* The position requires precise communication skills
* The position requires the ability to influence and convince
* The position requires negotiation skills


****Activités****
 Lead plant maintenance, Project Panning, and execution in alignment with strategic objectives for production, safety, and resource efficiency. Ensures strong HSEQ compliance while driving process optimization, energy efficiency, and carbon neutrality initiatives. Manages contractor activities and collaborates with local authorities to foster innovation. Provides effective leadership and mentorship, promoting continuous improvement and supporting expansion while maintaining high standards in quality, safety, and energy performance.
   

  

**VISION, MISSION, AND POLICIES**
* Drive the implementation of TELBU’s vision, mission, and HSSEQ policies in alignment with the Group HSEQ charter. Along with Project \& Maint Manager, provide support to Projects \& Maint team to ensure full adherence to the Group HSEQ charter, Company Rules, One\-Maestro standards, and local HSSEQ policies and procedures, guaranteeing that all operations are executed in accordance with established protocols


**COMPLIANCE \& STAKEHOLDERS ENGAGEMENT**
* Ensure full compliance with all regulatory obligations from authorities JAFZA, Dubai Municipality, Dubai Ports, Civil Defense, Customs, SIRA, and others. ensuring all necessary permits for Projects are obtained and consistently maintained
* Consistently uphold the company’s Code of Conduct and Ethics Policy by demonstrating integrity and professionalism, while ensuring full adherence to the compliance program, including policies and procedures on conflicts of interest, prevention of fraud, corruption, economic sanctions, and export control
* Promptly report any instance of noncompliance or violation of the any element of compliance program—especially those related to economic sanctions or export control—to the designated compliance officer or economic sanctions


**HSSEQ MANAGEMENT SYSTEM**
* Implement and effectively maintain relevant requirements of QMS (ISO 9001:2015\), EMS (14001:2015\), HS\-MS (ISO45001:2018\), EnMS (ISO 50001:2018\) through development of procedures.
* To effectively perform all nominated HSSEQ roles as part of One\-Maestro requirements and local HSSEQ procedures
* Strict adherence to Golden Rules, Near miss /Anomalies reporting, PTW compliance, Emergency Response procedures, Incident reporting and participation in investigation analysis.
* Effective participation of self and team in Risk Assessment and Critical Task Analysis Program, relevant HSSEQ trainings and other Programs (Safety Tours, Internal Audits, Joint Safety Tours etc).
* Ensure compliance with Loss control objectives, Quality HSSEQ \& Energy Policies, rules \& regulations and PPE requirements.
* Reporting of near misses, incidents, hazards \& injuries to line Manager within the time frame as required by Quality HSSEQ \& Energy Policies and Manuals.
* Implementing permit to work system and management of change process for projects \& Maintenance process within the plant.
* Support and execute assignment given by the Energy Manager to ensure ongoing compliance and effectiveness of EnMS
* Responsible for developing Technological Risk Assessment and FMEA for plant process equipment, utility and storage facility


**PROJECT PLANNING, SPECIFICATIONS AND APPROVALS**
* Prepare and finalize the annual Capex Long\-Term Plan in collaboration with all key stakeholders, including TE Lubrifiant OPE\-EIP department, MD, HODs, and the APMO Operations Head.
* Develop detailed technical specifications for projects and carry out comprehensive technical evaluations to facilitate tender committee decisions.
* Ensure timely preparation, initiation, and approval of AFEs and Capex Kiss Flow processes for all projects.


**PROJECT EXECUTION**
* Lead and manage the MOC process for new projects, modifications, and temporary installations.
* Collaborate with vendors, contractors, and site HSE teams to develop job method statements, risk assessments, and prevention plans, ensuring strict compliance with ICC/ISO 45001 standards and the permit\-to\-work system during project execution.
* Execute and finalize PSSR exercises for each project in coordination with all relevant stakeholders.


**PROJECT MONITORING, REVIEW \& REPORTING**
* Ensure project schedules and milestones are met by holding regular review meetings with contractors and collaborating closely with the purchasing department to achieve timely completion.
* Monitor and track the annual liquidation and commitment plan monthly to achieve KPI targets.
* Oversee project payment schedules to guarantee timely compliance with financial targets.
* Prepare and deliver project presentations for monthly departmental reviews with HODs, quarterly management reviews with the MD, APME Director Manufacturing, EIP, and business review sessions with the VP of Supply Chain \& Manufacturing.


**MAINTENANCE**
* Monitor and manage the OPEX budget to sustain TELBU assets.
* Implement predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance programs across all plant assets to meet annual production targets for lubricants and greases.
* Enhance operational efficiency by utilizing CMMS tools for maintenance planning, records, spare parts management, and KPI evaluation.
* Oversee facility management and AMC processes to ensure full compliance with vendor contractual agreements.
* Support Procurement in developing new suppliers for spare parts and machinery when required.
* Review and update maintenance procedures and systems to uphold best plant maintenance standards and ensure compliance with statutory and group guidelines.


**ASSET INTEGRITY**
* Oversee and support complete implementation of the asset integrity management system and ensure KPI alignment with organizational requirements.
* Perform FMEA, risk assessments, equipment classification, and energy evaluations for new equipment after project handover, updating maintenance processes as needed.
* Track and manage downgraded situations, ensuring corrective actions are executed and closed within defined timelines.


**AUDITS**
* Independently manage internal audits and manage key aspects of external audits, including ISO 9001, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, group audits (ONE MAESTRO, EDOC), IATF, and risk insurance audits.
* Support implementing action plans derived from audit results, ensuring prompt execution of corrective and preventive measures through OPEX and CAPEX initiatives.


**MANUFACTURING EXCELLENCE**
* Enhance processes by implementing lean tools such as DMAIC, 5S, and KAIZEN
* Research, submit, and implement CO2e reduction projects recommended by plant teams and groups


**PURPOSES**
* Achieve the KPI set for Projects \& Maintenance System
* Ensure safe execution of maintenance and project activities in compliance with HSSEQ requirement
* Improvements to the system / processes as agreed by the annual appraisal system – objectives


****Profil du candidat****
**Qualification**
* Degree / Diploma in any discipline of engineering – preferably mechanical / electrical / instrumentation
* Certificate course in AutoCAD added advantage


**Technical Skills**
* Proficiency in MS Office tools


**Specific certification**
* Academic Degree
* Computer literacy
* Project Management Professional (PMP)


**Soft Skills**
* Team management and manpower utilization
* Contractor Management
* Negotiation skills


**Specific knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of Electrical/ Electronics/ Mechanical Engineering.
* Extensive hands\-on expertise in managing industrial process control systems .
* Good knowledge on asset integrity management system,
* Good technical knowledge on packaging and process equipment, utility equipment like pumps, thermic heaters, air compressors, trouble shooting of equipment
* Good knowledge of multi\-discipline project management, especially brown field project execution experience
* Good knowledge of Energy Management, ISO 9000 \& ISO 14000, 45001 \& ISO 50001 standards, AutoCAD \& MS Project.


**Language Skills**
* English, Level: Fluent


**Experience**
* 8 – 10 years’ hands on experience in Project Management and Asset Integrity Management in a reasonably complex multinational environment preferably lubricants blending plant.


****Informations supplémentaires****
**TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats.**

data.jd_text:
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery of high\-end hospitality and residential development projects on behalf of the client. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of managing design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and schedule adherence. The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

The Senior Project Manager will act as a bridge between creative teams and stakeholders, managing resources, schedules, and deliverables.

 The responsibilities include defining project timelines and activities in collaboration with stakeholders, resolving changes in scope, issues and risks that impact project implementation, assigning talent and resources to projects, and guiding and coaching staff. The role requires excellent collaborative, time management and multi\-tasking skills. This individual should also be familiar with quality assurance practices to ensure products possess maximum functionality.
   

  





 The role will cover all aspects of project management throughout the whole project lifecycle from initial inception / business case through to completion.
   

  





**Duties include**

* Risk Management: Identifying potential risks and developing mitigation strategies.
* Budget Management: Tracking project expenses and ensuring adherence to budget guidelines.
